title: Recording: Goodnight Tonight by Wings | 1979
content:
Replica Studio, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

Wings continued recording the song ‘Goodnight Tonight’ on 22 January 1979.

Paul McCartney had taped the backing track almost a year before, at Abbey Road on 6 February 1978. He decided to complete it with the rest of Wings during this session.

Denny Laine and Laurence Juber added electric guitar parts, and Steve Holley overdubbed percussion. McCartney also recorded some vocals using a vocoder, and Juber added Flamenco-style guitar.

The recording of ‘Goodnight Tonight’ was completed on 24 January with new lead vocals.

Paul’s recording was unfinished, so we did some work on it in January 1979 at Replica Studio in the basement of the MPL Soho office in London. Denny and I did some electric parts echoing Paul’s existing lead guitar. I don’t remember who suggested the acoustic lead break, but the Spanish flavour was an obvious choice. I didn’t have an acoustic guitar with me, so I used Denny’s Ovasion Adamas guitar – it was very quick, a one-take flamenco flourish!
Laurence Juber
Paul McCartney: Music Is Ideas (1970-1989), Luca Perasi
